Required query parameters carry an example that reaches the 402. Free previews are named per door under x-csoai.free_preview. Catalog: https://councilof.ai/.well-known/x402.json and https://councilof.ai/api/x402. Verify is free: https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify. Every 402 carries a server-signed offer and every settled 200 a signed receipt, per the x402 Offer & Receipt extension (JWS/EdDSA, kid did:web:csoai.org#board-attestation-1, published at https://csoai.org/.well-known/did.json). Check either without trusting this document: POST it to /api/receipts/verify, or run scripts/verify_receipt.py, which reads did.json and contacts nobody. 22 axes measured · 14 model fleets · 3 public leader scores · 8 fact runs · TIE is TIE · not a certificate.
